detail.longDescription: The randomizer in this code keeps repeatedly getting long strings of B's. Is there any way I can make it more varied? import random import pyglet #opens window window = pyglet.window.Window(fullscreen=True) label = pyglet.text.Label('press A', font_name='Times New Roman', font_size=78, x=window.width//2, y=window.height//2, anchor_x='center', anchor_y='center') a1= pyglet.text.Label('press B', font_name='Times New Roman', font_size=78, x=window.width//2, y=window.height//2, anchor_x='center', anchor_y='center') def update(dt): v=random.SystemRandom().randint(1,2) if v==1: window.clear() label.draw() else: window.clear() a1.draw() pyglet.clock.schedule_interval(update,v) pyglet.app.run()
